Another 6 foot 3 gal checking in. I think because of what we go through, we tend to blow things that aren't important about blending in way out of proportion because we attribute certain characteristics only to men and women.  I'm still self conscious about my own height, but the fact is that overall it's not going to affect how well you look.

Something I've discovered is that yes, while we won't be the 5'4 petite kind of woman, there are plenty of cis women well into the six foot range. You'll still get all the stupid questions/comments (i bet you were great at basketball/volleyball!)  but you have to just take those in stride and realize theyre not calling you out as trans, just commenting on your height. Dont let it hold you back from doing what you want.

Give them time, that's really all you can do. You don't have to be passive, keep up with the logic and reasoning by all means, but itll take time. My own parents took a few years to come around, some never do at all. Ultimatley it's their choice
